model.note: Part outlines are traced from FJDynamics' product render (Z42P with the ball-picker attachment) and are approximate. FJD publishes no operator's manual, parts book or part numbers: the manual link opens FJD's archived Z42P product page, and everything here except the specifications is best practice. Get the manual and parts list from XCEL International, FJD's Australian distributor. FJD was arranging to collect the unit in Sep 2026: confirm it is staying before setting up PM jobs.

mast.name: Sensor mast
mast.desc: Frame that carries the RTK antennas and sensor housing above the operator. Daily: antennas undamaged; RTK accuracy drops if the rover antenna is damaged.

sensors.name: RTK antennas and sensor housing
sensors.desc: RTK GNSS positioning for the autonomous, remote and manual modes. Daily before an autonomous run: RTK fix good (base and rover antennas undamaged, base not moved), status lights normal, obstacle detection tested. Weekly: check for firmware and app updates. Annual dealer check of the sensors and RTK system; renew any subscription or correction service.

rtkbase.name: RTK base station
rtkbase.desc: Fixed base for the RTK correction. Accuracy drops if the base antenna is moved. Renew any subscription or correction service at the annual service.

body.name: Body and battery housing
body.desc: Rear body over the 6 kWh battery and drive. Clean weekly without high-pressure water on the electronics (water ingress is a known risk: wash gently). Weekly: check fasteners. Machine weighs about 335 kg; maximum slope 20 degrees, 10 degrees recommended.

battery.name: Battery, 6 kWh
battery.desc: 6 kWh lithium battery (chemistry not stated), about 5 h run. Daily: check charge level. Annual dealer battery health report. An optional petrol range-extender (6 L tank) is listed by FJD.

charger.name: Charger
charger.desc: 220 V AC charging: about 6 h standard, 4 h fast charge. Daily: charger and leads dry and undamaged.

drive.name: Drive motors
drive.desc: Electric drive. Annual dealer inspection of the drive motors.

tyreR.name: Rear drive wheels
tyreR.desc: Daily: no wrapped debris. Weekly: tyre condition and pressure (pressure not published: ask XCEL).

casterR.name: Front caster wheel, right
casterR.desc: Daily: no wrapped debris; weekly tyre condition check.

casterL.name: Front caster wheel, left
casterL.desc: Daily: no wrapped debris; weekly tyre condition check.

deck.name: Mower deck, 42 in.
deck.desc: 1,067 mm (42 in.) cut, height 30-127 mm, used when the Z42P mows. Daily: no wrapped debris. Annual dealer check of the deck and blade spindles.

spindle.name: Blade spindle
spindle.desc: Deck blade spindle. Annual dealer inspection.

blades.name: Mower blades
blades.desc: When mowing: blades sharp and tight (daily check). Part numbers not published: ask XCEL.

levers.name: Steering levers
levers.desc: Zero-turn steering levers for manual mode. Autonomous, remote and manual modes are available.

display.name: Control display
display.desc: Operator display on its post. Weekly: check for firmware and app updates.

estop.name: Emergency stop
estop.desc: Daily: test the emergency stop and the obstacle detection before an autonomous run. The range must be clear of people and obstacles; the SWP needs a supervised sign-off.

pkarm.name: Picker tow arm
pkarm.desc: Arm joining the ball-picker attachment to the machine. Weekly: check fasteners.

pkframe.name: Ball-picker attachment
pkframe.desc: Picker attachment for the driving range: 4 baskets, up to 1,800 balls, 120 kg, with automatic full-basket detection. Daily: baskets and picking units free of debris and damage; unload full baskets. Weekly: inspect the picking units, baskets and fasteners. No public part numbers or AUD prices: XCEL International (FJD's authorised AU distributor).

discR.name: Picking disc gang, rear
discR.desc: Disc gang that picks balls into the baskets. Daily: free of debris and damage. Weekly: inspect.

discF.name: Picking disc gang, front
discF.desc: Disc gang that picks balls into the baskets. Daily: free of debris and damage. Weekly: inspect.

caster.name: Picker caster wheel
caster.desc: Wheel carrying the picker frame. Daily: no wrapped debris.
